candidates.name: Langerhans cell histiocytosis
support_spans: a friable tumor with purulent discharge under the left thumbnail
subungual hemorrhages affecting most fingernails
erythematous, scaly papules with crusts
candidates.why: The combination of skin and nail lesions with specific histological features suggests this diagnosis.

candidates.name: subungual melanoma
support_spans: subungual hemorrhages affecting most fingernails
contradict_spans: testing for the BRAF V600E mutation was negative
candidates.why: The presence of subungual hemorrhages could suggest a melanocytic lesion, but the negative BRAF V600E mutation test reduces the likelihood.

candidates.name: Langerhans cell histiocytosis
support_spans: a diffuse infiltrate in the upper dermis of medium-to-large mononuclear cells with abundant eosinophilic cytoplasm and reniform nuclei
candidates.why: The specific histological features and immunohistochemical analysis support this diagnosis.

candidates.name: Erdheim-Chester disease
